choice.basis: The dashboard is a dual-axis plot (blue left axis for 0-19 years, red right axis for 20-39 years) with no visible y-axis tick values. While the blue 2012 mark is higher on the page than the red 2012 mark, the visible data labels for 2014 (89254 vs 92207) and 2018 (89332 vs 102807) show that the red series has higher values while being lower in screen space at those points. This confirms the axes use non-comparable scales, meaning screen height does not indicate which 2012 population is larger. Without explicit 2012 values or a scale bridge, the comparison is unresolved.
choice.option_label: Send 2012 age-cohort comparison to routine archive
